name: medmcqa_solution_purity
description: Rewards final answers that are exactly a single letter A-D in the solution tag. Penalizes answers with extra text, with the penalty increasing with the length of the extra text.

name: medmcqa_repetition_4gram
description: Penalizes repetitive 4-gram patterns in the output to reduce degeneration.

name: medmcqa_thinking_length_balance
description: Penalizes missing or extremely short/long thinking blocks to encourage concise but sufficient reasoning.

name: medmcqa_correct_conciseness_ratio
description: Rewards correct answers that are more concise than the average correct answer in the same group. Incorrect answers are penalized.

name: medmcqa_group_divergence_penalty
description: Penalizes answers that diverge from the most common prediction in the group. Unanimous groups get a small bonus for all members.

name: medmcqa_answer_position
description: Rewards correct answers that are concise in the solution tag.

name: medmcqa_option_coverage
description: Rewards reasoning that explicitly considers all four options (A-D) in the thinking block, encouraging comprehensive evaluation of alternatives.

name: medmcqa_reasoning_depth
description: Rewards reasoning that uses logical connectors to show causal or inferential steps, indicating deeper reasoning rather than just listing facts.

name: medmcqa_group_disagreement_penalty
description: Rewards answers that align with the majority prediction of the group, with stronger rewards for stronger consensus. Penalizes dissenting answers, especially when the group is unanimous.

name: medmcqa_partial_credit_elimination
description: Grants partial credit (1.0-1.75) to incorrect answers that demonstrate elimination of at least one wrong option, otherwise penalizes (-1.0). Correct answers get max score (5.0).

name: medmcqa_verification_check
description: Rewards outputs that include verification or double-checking of the answer.

name: medmcqa_thinking_structure
description: Rewards thinking blocks that follow a clear structure: identifying the question, analyzing options, and drawing a conclusion. Encourages organized reasoning.

name: medmcqa_length_efficiency
description: Rewards correct answers that have a length in the ideal range (around 1000 characters), using a Gaussian curve. Penalizes incorrect answers, with longer incorrect answers receiving heavier penalties.

name: medmcqa_rambling_penalty
description: Penalizes long thinking blocks that contain repetitive or low-information-density content, discouraging rambling.

name: medmcqa_group_majority_bonus
description: Rewards answers that match the majority prediction of the group, with the bonus scaling with the strength of consensus. Dissenting answers are penalized.

name: medmcqa_verification_step_bonus
description: Rewards outputs that include explicit verification or double-checking steps in the reasoning, promoting careful answer validation.

name: medmcqa_hallucination_penalty
description: Penalizes high-confidence incorrect answers to discourage hallucination and overconfidence.

name: medmcqa_truncation_malformed_penalty
description: Penalizes truncated outputs (missing closing tags) and malformed final answers. Rewards well-formed, complete outputs with a score of 0.0.

name: medmcqa_option_exclusion
description: Grants partial credit for explicitly reasoning why incorrect options are wrong.

name: medmcqa_thinking_density
description: Rewards reasoning that contains a healthy density of medical domain keywords, penalizing generic rambling or keyword stuffing. Encourages specific, domain-relevant reasoning.

name: medmcqa_group_relative_length
description: Rewards completions that are shorter than the group average (negative z-score) and penalizes those that are longer, promoting efficiency relative to peers.

name: medmcqa_group_consistency
description: Rewards answers that match the majority vote within the same question group, promoting consensus.

name: medmcqa_step_count
description: Rewards structured reasoning with clear step markers.

name: medmcqa_truncation_penalty
description: Penalizes truncated outputs (missing closing tags) and malformed final answers (not a single letter A-D). Rewards well-formed, complete outputs.

name: medmcqa_solution_format_strict
description: Rewards strict format compliance where the final answer is a single letter A-D inside the solution tag.

name: medmcqa_length_relative
description: Penalizes completions that are significantly longer or shorter than the group average.

name: medmcqa_efficiency_ratio
description: Rewards correct answers that are more concise than the average correct answer in the same group. Penalizes verbose correct answers and all incorrect answers.

name: medmcqa_answer_conciseness
description: Rewards concise final answers that are exactly a single letter A-D (3.0). Penalizes extra text in the solution tag proportionally to its length.

name: medmcqa_explicit_penalty_wrong_format
description: Applies a heavy penalty (-1.5 to -2.0) for malformed final answers that are not exactly a single letter A-D, ensuring strict format compliance.

name: medmcqa_confidence_calibration
description: Calibrates confidence by rewarding high-confidence correct answers and penalizing high-confidence incorrect answers. Encourages the model to be sure when it is right and to hedge when it is uncertain or wrong.
